# Figures {#sec-figures}
 
```{r} 
#| label: 'set-rda-dir-figs'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| eval: true
figures_dir <- fs::path('/Users/jim/_mymods/pollock/asar', 'figures')
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'fig-model_timeseries-setup'
#| echo: false 
#| warnings: false 
#| eval: true
# load rda
load(file.path(figures_dir, 'model_timeseries_figure.rda'))

# save rda with plot-specific name
model_timeseries_plot_rda <- rda

# remove generic rda object
rm(rda)

# save figure, caption, and alt text as separate objects
model_timeseries_plot <- model_timeseries_plot_rda$figure
model_timeseries_cap <- model_timeseries_plot_rda$cap
model_timeseries_alt_text <- model_timeseries_plot_rda$alt_text
``` 

```{r} 
#| label: 'fig-model_timeseries'
#| echo: false 
#| warning: false 
#| fig-cap: !expr model_timeseries_cap 
#| fig-alt: !expr model_timeseries_alt_text
model_timeseries_plot
```
